title: Kidney CT scan (for stones)
what: Quick cross-section images of your kidneys and urinary tract. Even very small stones show up.
why: For kidney colic, blood in the urine, possible stones, or to check after stone treatment.
duration: usually 5 to 10 minutes in the room; the report the same day, quickly if you have colic
tell_doctor: If you are or might be pregnant
If contrast is ordered: any allergy to iodine or contrast dye, kidney disease, and diabetes

prepare.title: Without contrast
prepare.text: Usually no prep. Sometimes you are asked to come with a full bladder. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: With contrast
prepare.text: Usually no food for 3 to 4 hours. Water is fine. A creatinine blood test is often needed.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: No metal on the belly or lower back.

bring: Past kidney ultrasounds and CT scans
steps: You lie on the table, and the technician helps you get comfortable
The table moves into the wide ring of the scanner
Keep still, and sometimes hold your breath on command
If contrast is used, it goes into a vein and images are taken with pauses
feel: It does not hurt. The scanner hums quietly
The ring is wide, so it does not feel cramped
With contrast: warmth through the body and a feeling as if you wet yourself. This is normal and passes quickly
after: You can go back to your day right away
Drink water, unless your doctor limited it
Take the report to a urologist
red_flags: Severe pain in your side that does not go away, a fever over 38°C (100.4°F), chills, or vomiting: call emergency services
After contrast: itching, a rash, a swollen face, or trouble breathing. Tell the staff right away or call emergency services

faq.q: Why CT and not ultrasound for stones?
faq.a: CT sees almost all stones, even small ones, and shows their exact size. Ultrasound is done first, CT for accuracy.

faq.q: Is there a lot of radiation?
faq.a: A lower dose is often used for stones. Your doctor orders CT when the benefit outweighs the risk.

reminders.text: Kidney CT soon. If contrast is used, do not eat for 3 to 4 hours. Water is fine.
